A sequence of non-blank lines that cannot be interpreted as other kinds of blocks forms a [paragraph](@). An [ATX heading](@) An [indented code block](@) is composed of one or more [indented chunks] separated by blank lines. An [HTML block](@) is a group of lines that is treated as raw HTML (and will not be escaped in HTML output). A [link reference definition](@) The following rules define [block quotes]: The following rules define [list items]: Any ASCII punctuation character may be backslash-escaped: A [code span](@) begins with a backtick string and ends with a backtick string of equal length. The following rules define emphasis and strong emphasis: A link contains [link text] (the visible text), a [link destination] (the URI that is the link destination), and optionally a [link title]. [Autolink](@)s are absolute URIs and email addresses inside `<` and `>`. A line ending (not in a code span or HTML tag) that is preceded by two or more spaces and does not occur at the end of a block is parsed as a [hard line break](@) (rendered in HTML as a `
` tag): Any characters not given an interpretation by the above rules will be parsed as plain textual content.
